nativeImplementationRoots.rationale: Registry components own their native semantics and interaction internals.
Shared primitives are the only local boundary allowed to implement native controls.

nativeControlExceptions.rationale: A hidden native file input is required to open the browser file picker; the visible trigger uses the shared Button primitive.

foundationImports.rationale: Radix is an implementation foundation for shared beUI adapters, not a route-level component API.

externalVisualExceptions.rationale: Documented focus-only composer effect; it does not replace a semantic beUI control.
